gemini.title: Boundary Census Sex Age And Marital Status Small Area
gemini.abstract: Boundary Census Sex Age And Marital Status Small Area is an authoritative dataset published by Central Statistics Office Ireland. It represents boundary census sex age and marital status small area features using geometry geometry.
gemini.lineage: Published by Central Statistics Office Ireland as open statistics and census data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
